name: Spherical Harmonical Exponentiation
aliases: Ren et al. Spherical Harmonical Exponentiation
definition: A method that encodes visibility in the form of spherical harmonic vectors to provide directional occlusion.
summary: Spherical Harmonical Exponentiation encodes directional volumetric occlusion using spherical harmonic coefficients, leveraging exponentiation to efficiently combine visibility functions for real-time soft shadows.
